source: Massachusetts CTHRU -- Budget vs Actual (kv7m-35wn) for appropriation totals; Comptroller Spending (pegc-naaa) for payments by vendor
measure: state appropriations and actual expenses on accounts the Commonwealth names for immigrant, refugee or family-shelter purposes; recipients classified by appropriation, never by vendor name

excluded.name: New American Voters Grant Program
excluded.reason: voter registration, not an immigrant service or shelter

excluded.name: End Family Homelessness Reserve Fund
excluded.reason: general family homelessness, not the EA shelter system

excluded.name: Commission to End Homelessness Recommendations Reserve
Services to the Homeless Mentally Ill
Homeless Family Preference in Private Multi-Family
excluded.reason: general family homelessness, not the EA shelter system

account_selection.excluded_reason: These accounts match the purpose-word search but are general homelessness programs, not immigrant-designated ones. They carry $939M in FY2022-FY2027 spending between them. Folding that into an immigrant-spending headline would repeat exactly the overreach this page was built to avoid -- the earlier version of this analysis counted three federally qualified health centres as immigrant vendors because their names contained NEIGHBOR. A homeless shelter is not an immigrant program because both involve shelter.
account_selection.audit: Re-run the search over the terms above and every account it returns is either in tier 1, in tier 2, or in the excluded list with a reason. check_account_coverage() fails the run if a new one appears in none of the three.

method_note: Accounts selected by searching appropriation_account_name for purpose words. Classifying by appropriation asks what the money was appropriated to do. A vendor-name match cannot: the prior version of this analysis caught three federally qualified health centres on the substring NEIGHBOR and a dentist on MIRA.

not_disclosed.masshealth_claims: Individual medical claims. Not itemized by recipient in any public record; aggregate appropriation totals only.
not_disclosed.snap_ebt: Federally protected recipient data. Not itemized by recipient in any public record.
not_disclosed.why_no_estimate: An earlier version of this page carried $670M of modelled education and healthcare cost from the Center for Immigration Studies, an advocacy organisation. A model is not a record, so the boundary is stated instead of filled.

series.label: the shelter series the immigration dashboard and MASTER_DATA.md publish, per fiscal year
series.hand_editing: These figures are written by this script into MASTER_DATA.md and into the dashboard's SHIFT array. Editing either by hand will be overwritten and check-shelter-series.py will fail the build.

tier1.label: accounts whose own name identifies an immigrant, refugee or family-shelter purpose

accounts.15992625: Family Shelter / Supplemental Shelter Costs Reserve
accounts.40030111: Office of Refugees and Immigrants Administration
accounts.70040101: Emergency Assistance - Family Shelters and Services
accounts.70040103: Homeless Family EA Shelter Overflow - Hotels and Motels

tier2.label: general rental assistance, NOT immigrant-designated -- published separately and never added to tier 1

accounts.70049316: RAFT / Homeless Housing (rental and mortgage aid)

recipients.basis: payments under tier-1 appropriations, FY2022 onward
